verdict.rationale: Bank feeds are a fair question for accounting software like Moneybird, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers connecting bank or credit-card accounts or importing transactions automatically each day. The pack only covers the API, authentication, contacts, invoicing and customer payment options (iDEAL, credit card), and accepting card payments from customers is a different capability from importing bank or card transactions.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day
